blocks.en: Welcome to EVE Online! You are now a citizen of New Eden, an exciting and dangerous virtual world. This guide will lead you through your first few days in EVE. For a more general list of topics new players should know about, see the New Player Index.
blocks.zh: 欢迎来到 EVE Online！你现在是新伊甸的一员，这是一个激动人心又危机四伏的虚拟世界。本指南将带你度过在 EVE 中的最初几天。如需更全面的新手须知主题列表，请参阅新玩家索引。

blocks.en: Introduction to EVE
blocks.zh: EVE 简介

blocks.en: EVE is a game unlike many other MMOs. It doesn't just have unique mechanics, it also doesn't follow many of the conventions of other games. It may therefore be a good idea to familiarize yourself with some of the core aspects of the game, in order to have a better idea of what to expect:
blocks.zh: EVE 和许多其他 MMO 很不一样。它不仅有独特的机制，还打破了其他游戏的很多惯例。因此，最好先熟悉一下游戏的一些核心内容，对接下来会遇到什么心里有个底：

en: Notes for Experienced RPG Players New to EVE
zh: 写给初入 EVE 的资深 RPG 玩家

blocks.en: Accounts
blocks.zh: 账号

blocks.en: Main article: Accounts
blocks.zh: 主条目：账号

blocks.en: To play EVE you must first create an account. Your account name doesn't show up anywhere in game, and you can have up to three characters per account. You can have as many accounts as you like.
blocks.zh: 要玩 EVE，首先要注册账号。账号名不会在游戏中显示，每个账号最多可以有三个角色。账号数量不限。

blocks.en: If you were invited to EVE by a friend (i.e. you have a referral link), use it when creating your account, as you will get some free skill points (equivalent to about 2 to 6 weeks of training time). Additionally, your friend will receive a reward. It's possible to invite yourself to create additional accounts.
blocks.zh: 如果你是被朋友邀请来玩 EVE 的（即你有推荐链接），注册时请使用该链接，这样你会获得一些免费的技能点（相当于大约 2 到 6 周的训练时间）。此外，你的朋友也会获得奖励。你也可以邀请自己来注册更多账号。

blocks.en: Even if you were not invited, you can use a public invitation link. Those are often shared by streamers and YouTubers. Use a search engine to find them.
blocks.zh: 即使没人邀请你，也可以使用公开的邀请链接。主播和 YouTuber 经常分享这类链接，用搜索引擎就能找到。

blocks.en: Sadly, sometimes accounts are hacked. Observe basic security considerations to prevent this. On top of that, you should use Two-Factor Authentication.
blocks.zh: 遗憾的是，账号有时会被盗。请遵循基本的安全注意事项来防止被盗。除此之外，你还应该启用双重验证。

blocks.en: Character Creation
blocks.zh: 创建角色

blocks.en: Main article: Character Creator
blocks.zh: 主条目：角色创建器

blocks.en: Empire
blocks.zh: 帝国

blocks.en: The first decision you have to make is to choose an empire for your character. There are four major factions in the game: Amarr, Caldari, Gallente, and Minmatar. Your choice of empire influences the look of your character and your starting skills, but any character can learn to fly any faction's ships with minimal effort.
blocks.zh: 你要做的第一个决定是为角色选择一个帝国。游戏中有四大势力：艾玛、加达里、盖伦特和米玛塔尔。帝国的选择会影响角色的外貌和初始技能，但任何角色都可以轻松学会驾驶任何势力的舰船。

blocks.en: The only long-term gameplay consideration when choosing an empire is your starting system; at any time, you may remotely set your home station to the location of your school, a powerful ability allowing you to quickly travel across the galaxy by self-destructing. As such, Caldari is recommended because all of the Caldari schools are located three jumps from Jita, New Eden's main trade hub.
blocks.zh: 选择帝国时唯一需要长期考虑的是你的出生星系：你随时可以远程把基地空间站设置到你所在学校的位置，这是一项强大的功能，可以通过自毁快速穿越星系。因此推荐选择加达里，因为所有加达里学校都距离新伊甸的主要贸易中心吉他（Jita）三跳。

blocks.en: Bloodline
blocks.zh: 血统

blocks.en: A bloodline in EVE is a character's familial ancestry. There are three different bloodlines for every empire to choose from during character creation. From the character creation window: "Note: Bloodline selection will influence your character's appearance only. It does not affect access to skills or abilities."
blocks.zh: EVE 中的血统是角色的家族渊源。创建角色时，每个帝国都有三种不同的血统可供选择。角色创建窗口中写道：“注意：血统选择只会影响角色的外貌，不会影响技能或能力的获取。”

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: The bloodline you choose used to determine which NPC corporation your character will automatically join when no longer being part of a Player Corporation or Starter Corporation. This was changed: players now go back to their starter corp. But you might see some characters in NPC corps which aren't starter corps as they joined those before the change.
blocks.zh: 过去，你选择的血统决定了角色在不属于任何玩家军团或新手军团时会自动加入哪个 NPC 军团。这一点已经改了：现在玩家会回到自己的新手军团。不过你可能还会看到有些角色待在非新手军团的 NPC 军团里，那是因为他们在改动之前就加入了。

blocks.en: School
blocks.zh: 学校

blocks.en: The School you choose will only determine which starter solar system you begin in, and which Starter Corporation you will be part of. Normally you are only allowed to change your home station remotely once per year, but you can always set it back to the station you started the game in.
blocks.zh: 你选择的学校只决定你从哪个新手星系出发，以及你会加入哪个新手军团。通常每年只能远程更改一次基地空间站，但你随时都可以把它改回游戏开始时所在的空间站。

blocks.en: All Caldari schools' home stations are three jumps from Jita, allowing prompt access to New Eden's main trade hub. A full list of schools and their starting systems can be found here.
blocks.zh: 所有加达里学校的基地空间站都距离吉他三跳，可以快速前往新伊甸的主要贸易中心。学校及其出生星系的完整列表见这里。

blocks.en: Portrait and Appearance
blocks.zh: 头像与外貌

blocks.en: Next, you have to design your character's appearance and take a portrait. Your looks depend in part on which empire and bloodline you chose, but the tool also gives you a lot of flexibility. Do spend some time crafting your character and taking your portrait, but keep in mind that 99% of the time other players will only ever see your portrait and not your entire character model, and so will you.
blocks.zh: 接下来，你需要设计角色的外貌并拍摄头像。外貌部分取决于你选择的帝国和血统，但这个工具也给了你很大的自由度。可以花点时间打造角色、拍摄头像，但要记住，99% 的情况下其他玩家只会看到你的头像而不是完整的角色模型，你自己也一样。

blocks.en: You can change your character's clothing and re-take your portraits at any point later, but changing your character's physical appearance can only be done by paying for "Character Remodeling" with PLEX (through the New Eden Store).
blocks.zh: 之后你随时可以更换角色服装、重新拍摄头像，但要改变角色的身体外貌，只能通过新伊甸商店使用伊甸币（PLEX）购买“角色重塑”服务。

blocks.en: Name
blocks.zh: 名字

blocks.en: Pick your character's name carefully, as you can never change it later. Your name is part of your identity, and it will influence how your corpmates think of you.
blocks.zh: 请慎重选择角色名，因为以后永远无法更改。名字是你身份的一部分，会影响军团成员对你的印象。

blocks.en: In EVE Online, most corporations make use of voice communication (e.g. Discord voice channels or Mumble) during fleet operations, and also use their voice server available for casual chatter. You will sometimes need to identify yourself with your name while using voice comms, and other fleetmates will use your name to give you intel or instructions. Having a name that is simple and easily pronounceable will make things easier for everyone.
blocks.zh: 在 EVE Online 中，大多数军团在舰队行动时会使用语音通讯（例如 Discord 语音频道或 Mumble），平时也会在语音服务器上闲聊。使用语音时你有时需要报出自己的名字，其他舰队成员也会用你的名字来给你报情报或下指令。名字简单好念，大家都方便。

blocks.en: Pick your name carefully, especially your first name, as that will often be used as your callsign during fleet operations. If you pick a stupid name for yourself, you should prepare for some people to not take you seriously. Choosing something unpronounceable will make it more cumbersome for enemy fleet commanders to call you primary, but on the other hand it may introduce some difficulty in your own fleet as well.
blocks.zh: 请慎重选择名字，尤其是名（first name），因为在舰队行动中它通常会被当作你的呼号。如果你给自己起了个蠢名字，就要做好有些人不把你当回事的准备。起一个念不出来的名字会让敌方舰队指挥点你为首要目标时更费劲，但另一方面，也可能给你自己的舰队带来麻烦。

blocks.en: You can pick a first and last name (although the last name is optional). Character names are unique, and the game will check whether your chosen name is available before letting you proceed.
blocks.zh: 你可以选择名和姓（姓是可选的）。角色名是唯一的，游戏会先检查你选的名字是否可用，然后才让你继续。

blocks.en: Starting the game
blocks.zh: 开始游戏

blocks.en: Tutorial
blocks.zh: 教程

blocks.en: Main article: AIR New Player Experience
blocks.zh: 主条目：AIR 新玩家体验

blocks.en: When you first start the game as a new character, you can go through the tutorial (called the "New Player Experience"), a story-driven experience that gives you step-by-step instructions on the basic mechanics of playing EVE. Unless you've already played the game, it is highly recommended that you follow the tutorial, as there are many particular mechanics which you may not be used to.
blocks.zh: 第一次以新角色进入游戏时，你可以进行教程（称为“新玩家体验”），这是一段剧情驱动的体验，会一步步教你 EVE 的基本玩法机制。除非你已经玩过这个游戏，否则强烈建议跟着教程走，因为有很多特殊机制可能是你不熟悉的。

blocks.en: Career Agents
blocks.zh: 生涯代理人

blocks.en: Main article: Career Agents
blocks.zh: 主条目：生涯代理人

blocks.en: After the tutorial, you can learn more about EVE by visiting the career agents and doing the missions they offer. Their missions introduce you to some of the main PvE activities in EVE Online. Keep in mind that Career agents offer little training in PvP, which makes up a substantial part of the game. Additionally, EVE is a sandbox game, and much of its attraction is forging your own path as opposed to following a pre-set path.
blocks.zh: 完成教程后，你可以拜访生涯代理人，完成他们提供的任务，进一步了解 EVE。这些任务会向你介绍 EVE Online 中一些主要的 PvE 活动。请记住，生涯代理人几乎不提供 PvP 方面的训练，而 PvP 是游戏中相当重要的一部分。此外，EVE 是一款沙盒游戏，它的魅力很大程度上在于走出自己的道路，而不是沿着预设的路线前进。

blocks.en: If you followed the tutorial, you will have flown to the station housing the nearest career agents. If you skipped the tutorial, you can locate the closest set of career agents (there are three sets of agents per faction, but they all offer the same missions).
blocks.zh: 如果你完成了教程，你应该已经飞到了最近的生涯代理人所在的空间站。如果你跳过了教程，可以找到离你最近的一组生涯代理人（每个势力有三组代理人，但他们提供的任务都一样）。

blocks.en: You can do the agents in any order you like (although you should do the Explorer agent before you do the Soldier of Fortune one).
blocks.zh: 你可以按任意顺序完成这些代理人的任务（不过探险家代理人的任务应该在自由战士代理人之前完成）。

blocks.en: Completing the career agents missions will reward some ships and skillbooks.
blocks.zh: 完成生涯代理人任务可以获得一些舰船和技能书作为奖励。

blocks.en: AIR Career Program
blocks.zh: AIR 职业计划

blocks.en: Main article: AIR Career Program
blocks.zh: 主条目：AIR 职业计划

blocks.en: This is a reward programme for reaching certain goals. These goals are reached more or less automatically while doing stuff in EVE. Rewards come in the form of ISK, skillbooks, skill points, Expert Systems and ships. Some example goals are completing career agent missions, buying stuff on the market and gaining standings with a corporation things you are doing anyway.
blocks.zh: 这是一个达成特定目标即可获得奖励的计划。在 EVE 里正常玩的时候，这些目标多少都会自然达成。奖励包括 ISK、技能书、技能点、专家系统和舰船。例如完成生涯代理人任务、在市场上买东西、提升对某个军团的声望等，都是你反正会做的事情。

blocks.en: For example: There are 4 gaining standings goals Which will get you the Social (for the first) and Connections (for the third) skillbooks and a total of 200,000 ISK just by doing what you are doing anyway.
blocks.zh: 举个例子：有 4 个提升声望目标，只要做你本来就在做的事，就能获得社会学（第一个目标）和关系学（第三个目标）技能书，以及总计 200,000 ISK。

blocks.en: AIR Daily Goals
blocks.zh: AIR 每日目标

blocks.en: Main article: AIR Daily Goals
blocks.zh: 主条目：AIR 每日目标

blocks.en: This is a continuous rewards program for reaching goals on a daily base. Reaching a goal rewards ISK and EverMarks. Reaching 2 goals a day rewards skillpoints. The program gives additional ISK and skillpoints for a monthly 12 step progress track.
blocks.zh: 这是一个按天达成目标、持续发放奖励的计划。达成一个目标可获得 ISK 和永恒印记（EverMark）。每天达成 2 个目标可获得技能点。该计划还设有每月 12 阶的进度条，可额外获得 ISK 和技能点。

blocks.en: The Sisters of EVE Epic Arc: Blood-Stained Stars
blocks.zh: EVE 姐妹会史诗任务线：血染星辰

blocks.en: Main article: The Blood-Stained Stars
blocks.zh: 主条目：血染星辰

blocks.en: Lesson Learned
blocks.zh: 经验教训

blocks.en: Be wary that many miscreant players and corporations hang around SoE systems to prey upon New Players.
blocks.zh: 要当心，很多不怀好意的玩家和军团会在姐妹会星系附近游荡，专门猎杀新玩家。

blocks.en: After you have completed the missions for the career agents, the EVE galaxy is yours to explore! Should you like to run a few more story-related missions, you can do the Sisters of EVE epic mission arc "The Blood-Stained Stars". The epic arc is a series of 50 connected missions which take you all over highsec and expose you to quite a bit of the background and lore of the game, particularly concerning the Rogue Drones and the secret Society of Conscious Thought. To start it you should go to the Arnon system and talk to Sister Alitura at the Sisters of EVE Bureau.
blocks.zh: 完成生涯代理人的任务后，整个 EVE 星系任你探索！如果你还想再做一些剧情任务，可以做 EVE 姐妹会的史诗任务线“血染星辰”（The Blood-Stained Stars）。这条史诗任务线由 50 个相互关联的任务组成，会带你走遍高安，让你了解大量游戏背景和故事设定，尤其是关于自由无人机和神秘的真理会的内容。要开始这条任务线，请前往 阿尔蒙 星系，与 EVE 姐妹会办事处的 Alitura 修女对话。

blocks.en: While doing the epic arc, you should focus on continuing to train your combat skills. You can do most of the initial missions in a Frigate, but you should consider upgrading to a Destroyer or even a Cruiser towards the end.
blocks.zh: 做史诗任务线的同时，应该专注于继续训练战斗技能。前期的大部分任务可以用护卫舰完成，但到后期应该考虑升级到驱逐舰甚至巡洋舰。

blocks.en: Most of the missions will be fairly easy, but some (particularly towards the end, like the infamous "Burning Down the Hive" or "Our Man Dagan") have a reputation for being very challenging for new players. If you find yourself struggling, don't be shy to ask for help in the E-UNI chat channel as many EVE University players would be happy to help you.
blocks.zh: 大多数任务都比较简单，但有些任务（尤其是后期的，比如臭名昭著的“焚毁巢穴”或“我们的人达甘”）出了名地难，对新玩家来说很有挑战。如果你觉得吃力，不要不好意思在 E-UNI 聊天频道里求助，很多 EVE University 的玩家都乐意帮忙。

blocks.en: By contrast, be careful about accepting or asking for help in the Local chat channel, as some unscrupulous players who might hijack your mission objective, or bait you and destroy your ship (see also: scams in EVE Online).
blocks.zh: 相反，在本地频道里接受或请求帮助时要小心，有些无良玩家可能会抢走你的任务目标，或者引诱你上钩然后击毁你的舰船（另见：EVE Online 中的骗局）。

blocks.en: Learning Skills
blocks.zh: 学习技能

blocks.en: Main article: Skills and learning
blocks.zh: 主条目：技能与学习

blocks.en: Unlike in many other MMOs, in EVE your character advances (gains new abilities, can use additional modules and ships, et cetera) through training skills, which are trained in real time, even when you are logged off. Therefore, you should always have a skill actively training.
blocks.zh: 与许多其他 MMO 不同，在 EVE 中角色的成长（获得新能力、能使用更多装备和舰船等）是通过训练技能实现的，技能按现实时间训练，即使下线也会继续。因此，你应该始终保持有技能在训练。

blocks.en: You can queue up skills to be trained one after the other, nearly infinitely (or until the 5 million skill point cap for Alpha characters). Skills have five levels (I through V), and while the benefits of each additional level scale linearly, the training time increases exponentially: it's usually not worth training skills beyond level IV in your first few days. Instead, focus on the skills which either improve whatever you're doing at the moment, or which unlock new ships or modules you want to try.
blocks.zh: 你可以把技能排进队列依次训练，几乎没有上限（Alpha 角色则以 500 万技能点为上限）。技能有五个等级（I 到 V），每提升一级带来的收益是线性增长的，但训练时间却呈指数增长：在最初几天里，通常不值得把技能练到 IV 级以上。应该专注于那些能提升你当前所做事情的技能，或者能解锁你想尝试的新舰船或装备的技能。

blocks.en: As you get a feel for what you enjoy doing in EVE you can focus your training in that particular area. Skills are cumulative, and a character (provided they have an Omega clone) can potentially learn every skill in the game given enough time. It is even possible to "extract " spent skill points and apply them elsewhere, for a price. So don't worry too much about training "the wrong skill" at the start of the game.
blocks.zh: 等你摸清自己在 EVE 中喜欢做什么之后，就可以把训练集中在那个方向上。技能是累积的，只要时间足够，一个角色（前提是拥有 Omega 克隆）有可能学会游戏中的所有技能。甚至可以花钱把已用掉的技能点“提取”出来再用到别处。所以在游戏初期不必太担心练了“错误的技能”。

blocks.en: You start the game with a number of skills already trained. To train additional skills, you must first acquire the appropriate skillbook. While you will receive a number of skillbooks as rewards from the career agents and the AIR Career Program, the others must be bought on the market; most of the basic skillbooks are reasonably cheap. EVE University provides certain skillbooks for free to its members.
blocks.zh: 游戏开始时你已经训练好了一些技能。要训练更多技能，必须先获得相应的技能书。生涯代理人和 AIR 职业计划会奖励你一些技能书，其他的则要在市场上购买；大多数基础技能书都相当便宜。EVE University 会为成员免费提供部分技能书。

blocks.en: You can speed up your training time by installing implants in your character, specifically the basic attribute-enhancing implants, which add between +1 and +5 points to your character's attributes. While the better implants are extremely expensive, +1 implants are affordable even for new players. Members of EVE University can also buy +3 implants at a discount.
blocks.zh: 你可以给角色安装植入体来加快训练速度，特别是基础的属性增强植入体，可为角色属性增加 +1 到 +5 点。好的植入体极其昂贵，但 +1 植入体连新玩家也买得起。EVE University 的成员还可以折价购买 +3 植入体。

blocks.en: Fitting your Ship
blocks.zh: 装配舰船

blocks.en: Main article: Fitting ships
blocks.zh: 主条目：装配舰船

blocks.en: Ships in EVE can be fitted with a wide variety of modules that grant the ship additional abilities (e.g. weapons, which allow you to fire at enemy ships) or enhance its statistics (e.g. armor plates, which increase the amount of damage your ship can take before exploding). Learning which modules work well on which ship (and in combination with which other modules) is a potentially very deep topic, so you should approach it step by step. Basic guidelines to each of the four factions' core ships can be found on the following pages:
blocks.zh: EVE 中的舰船可以装配各种各样的装备，这些装备能赋予舰船额外的能力（例如武器，让你能向敌舰开火），或增强舰船的属性（例如装甲板，增加舰船在爆炸前能承受的伤害量）。哪些装备适合哪些舰船（以及与哪些其他装备搭配）是一门可能非常深奥的学问，所以应该循序渐进。以下页面提供了四大势力核心舰船的基础指南：

en: Amarr Basic Ship and Skill Overview
Caldari Basic Ship and Skill Overview
Gallente Basic Ship and Skill Overview
Minmatar Basic Ship and Skill Overview
ORE Basic Ship and Skill Overview
zh: 艾玛基础舰船与技能概览
加达里基础舰船与技能概览
盖伦特基础舰船与技能概览
米玛塔尔基础舰船与技能概览
联合矿业基础舰船与技能概览

blocks.en: Additionally, there is a complete list of all modules and rigs, and what they do. EVE University members can also ask for fitting advice in the #fitting-chat Discord channel.
blocks.zh: 此外，还有一份所有装备和改装件及其作用的完整列表。EVE University 成员也可以在 Discord 的 #fitting-chat 频道询问装配建议。

blocks.en: It's also a good idea to set up PYFA, a popular tool that lets you build and simulate fittings out of game. PYFA will let you easily simulate fittings and see what skills you'll need to train to fly them.
blocks.zh: 安装 PYFA 也是个好主意，这是一款很受欢迎的工具，可以在游戏外搭建和模拟装配。用 PYFA 可以轻松模拟装配，并查看驾驶它们需要训练哪些技能。

blocks.en: Joining a Corporation
blocks.zh: 加入军团

blocks.en: Corporations are EVE's version of player organisations, vaguely similar to guilds or clans in other games, but with more scope for influencing the game. EVE is, at its heart, a social game, and while it's perfectly possible to play the game by yourself, most long-time EVE players cite the sense of community in their corporation as one of the main attractions of the game. Additionally, a well-run corporation can offer many services to its members, such as free ships and modules, help moving assets around New Eden, missioning support, advice, a sense of banding together with other to achieve common goals, and of course, fun fleet operations.
blocks.zh: 军团是 EVE 中的玩家组织，有点类似其他游戏中的公会或战队，但对游戏的影响范围更大。EVE 本质上是一款社交游戏，虽然完全可以一个人玩，但大多数 EVE 老玩家都认为军团中的社群归属感是这款游戏的主要魅力之一。此外，运营良好的军团可以为成员提供许多服务，例如免费的舰船和装备、帮忙在新伊甸各地搬运资产、任务支援、建议、与他人携手实现共同目标的团结感，当然还有有趣的舰队行动。

blocks.en: EVE University is a corporation dedicated to teaching new players how to play and enjoy EVE. We provide a wide variety of services (beyond teaching and a very helpful community), such as free skillbooks, subsidised implants, mentors, and communities to provide hands-on experience in a wide variety of locations and environments in EVE, not to mention the awesome wiki you're currently reading. We welcome applications from all new players.
blocks.zh: EVE University 是一个致力于教新玩家玩 EVE、享受 EVE 的军团。除了教学和一个非常乐于助人的社群之外，我们还提供各种服务，例如免费技能书、植入体补贴、导师，以及让你在 EVE 各种地点和环境中获得实践经验的分部社群，更不用说你正在阅读的这个超棒的 wiki 了。我们欢迎所有新玩家申请加入。

blocks.en: However, there are other corporations (large or small, casual or formal, located in all corners of space) in EVE who are very welcoming to new players, and every player should look around to see what best suits their interests and temperament. Corporations advertise in:
blocks.zh: 不过，EVE 中还有其他非常欢迎新玩家的军团（规模有大有小，风格有休闲有正规，分布在宇宙的各个角落），每位玩家都应该多看看，找到最适合自己兴趣和性格的军团。军团会在以下地方发布招募信息：

en: The in-game corporation finder
The official corporation recruitment forum
EVE University's #work-fair Discord channel
/r/evejobs on Reddit
zh: 游戏内的军团查找工具
官方军团招募论坛
EVE University 的 #work-fair Discord 频道
Reddit 上的 /r/evejobs

blocks.en: Next steps
blocks.zh: 下一步

blocks.en: Main article: Careers
blocks.zh: 主条目：职业

blocks.en: EVE is a sandbox game, which means it's up to each player to find what they enjoy doing most in the game; while CCP do foster some fiction about the game universe, there isn't a central story to follow.
blocks.zh: EVE 是一款沙盒游戏，也就是说要靠每位玩家自己去发现最喜欢做的事情；虽然 CCP 确实在构建游戏宇宙的故事设定，但并没有一条需要跟随的主线剧情。

blocks.en: Due to EVE's skill system, it's usually easy to start doing a given activity, and to get to a decent skill level, but it takes a while to master it to its fullest. Therefore, as a new player, it's often a good idea to dabble in a few different activities to find out what suits you best. If you've found something that looks appealing, research it (e.g. by searching this wiki, attending a class, or chatting to your corp-mates), start learning the appropriate skills, and get started. If you find it enjoyable, keep training your character's skills while honing your player skills and experience; should you grow bored, you can always switch up your character's training queue and try something else.
blocks.zh: 由于 EVE 的技能系统，开始某项活动并达到不错的技能水平通常很容易，但要完全精通则需要一段时间。因此，作为新玩家，多尝试几种不同的活动、找出最适合自己的，往往是个好主意。如果你发现了感兴趣的东西，就去研究一下（例如搜索这个 wiki、参加课程，或者和军团成员聊聊），开始学习相应的技能，然后动手去做。如果觉得好玩，就继续训练角色技能，同时磨练你作为玩家的技术和经验；如果玩腻了，随时可以调整角色的技能队列，尝试别的东西。

blocks.en: While playing the game, you may want to keep in mind:
blocks.zh: 玩游戏的过程中，你可能需要记住：

en: Tips for New Players, a list of some common mistakes new players make and how best to avoid them
Golden Rules of EVE Online
zh: 新玩家小贴士，列出了新玩家常犯的一些错误以及如何避免
EVE Online 金科玉律

blocks.en: Getting help
blocks.zh: 获取帮助

blocks.en: EVE is a very complex (and sometimes counterintuitive) game. Should you feel unsure or lost, then don't hesitate to ask for help. The EVE player community is very friendly and helpful towards new players. The easiest way to get direct help is through in-game chat channels.
blocks.zh: EVE 是一款非常复杂（有时还很反直觉）的游戏。如果你感到不确定或迷茫，不要犹豫，尽管求助。EVE 玩家社群对新玩家非常友好、乐于助人。获得直接帮助最简单的方式是游戏内的聊天频道。

blocks.en: Chat channels
blocks.zh: 聊天频道

blocks.en: Joining chat channels.
blocks.zh: 加入聊天频道。

blocks.en: There are (at least) three chat channels dedicated to helping new players - you can ask questions here, and there are usually other experienced players and game masters around to help you. You can find these (and other) chat channels in tabs at (by default) the bottom-left of your screen.
blocks.zh: 有（至少）三个专门帮助新玩家的聊天频道——你可以在这里提问，通常会有其他有经验的玩家和 GM 在场帮忙。这些（以及其他）聊天频道位于屏幕（默认）左下角的标签页中。

en: Rookie Help (dedicated to helping the newest players.)
English Help (general English help chat. There are also help chat channels in French, German, Japanese and Russian.)
EVE University (EVE University's general help channel.)
zh: Rookie Help（新手帮助，专门帮助最新的玩家。）
English Help（英语帮助，综合性英语帮助频道。另外还有法语、德语、日语和俄语的帮助频道。）
EVE University（EVE University 的综合帮助频道。）

blocks.en: You automatically join the "Rookie Help" channel when you first start the game. Additional, you can join the "English help" or "EVE University" chat channels (as Rookie Help is often very busy, and characters older than 30 days no longer have access to "Rookie Help"):
blocks.zh: 第一次进入游戏时你会自动加入“Rookie Help”频道。此外，你还可以加入“English Help”或“EVE University”聊天频道（因为 Rookie Help 经常非常繁忙，而且创建超过 30 天的角色将无法再进入“Rookie Help”）：

en: Click on the speech bubble below the chat channel. You will see a number of folders.
Click on "Help" and look for channels named EVE University (E-UNI) and/or English Help (Help).
Click "Join".
zh: 点击聊天频道下方的对话气泡图标，你会看到若干个文件夹。
点击“Help”，找到名为 EVE University（E-UNI）和/或 English Help（Help）的频道。
点击“加入”（Join）。

blocks.en: Videos
blocks.zh: 视频

blocks.en: Some things are just more easily explained in a video than through text.
blocks.zh: 有些东西用视频讲解比用文字更容易明白。

en: EVE tutorial - Full career agents/SOE Epic arc tutorial videos mission by mission
How to Survive EVE Online video series by Seamus Donohue, which goes from character creation to the end of the career agents, with helpful commentary along the way.
zh: EVE 教程 - 完整的生涯代理人/姐妹会史诗任务线教程视频，逐个任务讲解
Seamus Donohue 的 How to Survive EVE Online 系列视频，从创建角色一直讲到完成生涯代理人任务，一路附有实用的讲解。

blocks.en: Deeper knowledge
blocks.zh: 深入学习

blocks.en: Beyond simple questions which can be answered in a chat channel, there is an enormous amount of knowledge about the game that the player base has documented. The EVE University wiki that you're reading right now is one of the most comprehensive resources for newer players, but there are many others, often dedicated to a particular activity in the game.
blocks.zh: 除了能在聊天频道里解答的简单问题之外，玩家群体还整理了海量的游戏知识。你正在阅读的 EVE University wiki 是对新玩家来说最全面的资源之一，但还有很多其他资源，通常专注于游戏中的某项特定活动。

blocks.en: Using your favourite internet search engine is usually a good starting point, but keep in mind that EVE is constantly evolving, so check whether the information you find is current. Additionally, the official EVE help centre is a good place to find information relating to your subscription, account services, and basic gameplay.
blocks.zh: 用你常用的搜索引擎搜索通常是个不错的起点，但要记住 EVE 一直在更新，所以要确认找到的信息是否仍然有效。此外，官方的 EVE 帮助中心是查找订阅、账号服务和基础玩法相关信息的好地方。
